profile.introduction: I build web and mobile products, backend services, and AI features, with engineering experience since 2019.
profile.professionalSummary: I am Muhammad Reebal Raza, a full-stack developer based in Islamabad. My experience spans project-based freelance work since 2019, senior development at New Avenue, and technical ownership at Vicots. I work across React, React Native, Node.js, Python/Flask, databases, AWS, and AI integrations, from application architecture and data pipelines to interfaces, testing, and delivery.

projects.name: GoHosty
projects.title: Rental operations | Vicots
projects.summary: Major full-stack ownership within a team, covering backend services, REST APIs, PostgreSQL data models, React interfaces, security, optimization, and error reporting.

contributions: Wrote Jest tests and database migrations, and optimized SQL queries.

The platform supports booking workflows, custom Redis-based chat, Stripe payments, and property operations.
